exclusionNote: The rules decision, reason, reason code, evidence ids, and closeness are not features. Closeness is missing on every cleared hit, so using it would leak the outcome.
labelRule: Labels are read only from the inverse-scaled k-means centre. Conflicting: mean of the three Different indicators is at least 0.30. High agreement: that conflict test fails and mean Match is at least 0.55. Thin comparison: mean Match and mean Different are both under 0.25. Otherwise mixed.

hdbscan.silhouetteNote: Silhouette uses only non-noise points, and only when HDBSCAN found at least two clusters.
